content.title: EU proposes €45bn loan for Ukraine to avert cash crisis and boost defences
content.caption: The European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, announced a €45bn (£37.5bn) loan for Ukraine to help with a looming cash crisis and reinforce its defences.

slides.heading: EU proposes €45bn loan for Ukraine to avert cash crisis
slides.text: The European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, announced a €45bn (£37.5bn) loan for Ukraine to help with a looming cash crisis and reinforce its defences.

slides.heading: Relevant context
slides.text: The EU executive has proposed a €45bn (£37.5bn) loan for Ukraine to help with a looming cash crisis and reinforce its defences, as Russia’s relentless bombardment continues.

slides.heading: Important details
slides.text: The loan is split into two parts: €25bn for weapons and €20bn for civilian needs, including funding essential services such as schools and hospitals.
